title: SWF compile: StageScaleMode (tag 65) not emitted — stage scaling not specified in published SWFs
description: Tag 65 (StageScaleMode) is completely absent from compile.ts and the model. Flash Professional always emits this tag. Fix: emit tag 65 with AllowScaling=1 (showAll) and Alignment=0 (center) as fixed defaults immediately after the SetBackgroundColor tag (or in the header section with FileAttributes/Metadata). Add tag constant and a test asserting the tag appears in compiled output.
